drafted_from: tools/composed-space/packages/composed-space (do-work/save-space.ts, read-data/read-composed-spaces.ts) and its property list COMPOSED_SPACE_PROPS
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:keep-space-descriptors-as-revisions with store {\"where\": \"postgresql database example_me on my own computer\", \"language\": \"SQL (PostgreSQL)\", \"credential_name\": \"example-me-postgres-connection\"} and save the Space sp1 for the ledger scope, kind community, title \"Ledger club\", at revision 0 with key k1." It keeps the Space as its first revision in your own database and reads it back.
no_lists_because: It names no list of its own: the Space revisions are kept in the person's own store, in whatever form that store keeps things, and store says where and in which language.
instructions: 1. Keep the store's login in your vault under a name you choose, and say where the store is and how it is spoken to.
2. Say "Run workflow:keep-space-descriptors-as-revisions" with store and the save: the Space, its scope, kind, title, the revision you read it at, and a key of your own.
3. The first run makes the store's own objects once and proves them on the example saves: every expected outcome and answer must match, or the run stops and says which.
4. Every later run keeps the save as the next revision, repeated if its key was kept, or refused with the current revision, and reads the Space back.

worked_examples.title: A community Space kept at its first revision
worked_examples.ask: Make a Space called Ledger club for the ledger scope, a community.

store.where: postgresql database example_me on my own computer

worked_examples.given: The look step found no Space sp1 kept yet, so its expected revision is 0; the prove step matched every expected outcome and answer.
worked_examples.hands_back: outcome kept, with revision 1 and the title Ledger club.

worked_examples.title: A stale save is refused and names the current revision
worked_examples.ask: Rename Ledger club to Ledger club 2, from the revision I read earlier, which was 1.

store.where: postgresql database example_me on my own computer

worked_examples.given: The Space already sits at revision 1, so a save that expects revision 0 is stale.
worked_examples.hands_back: outcome refused, with the reason that the expected revision 0 is not the current revision 1, and revision 1 so the save can be read and tried again.
